# Jev

Jev is TypeSafe AI's System One API for discovering available models and evaluating structured state with Noul, Choice, and Score questions.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/jev/.

## Actions

- **Evaluate State** (read-only): Evaluate one shared state against one or more named Noul, Choice, or Score questions in parallel.
- **List Models** (read-only): List the Jev model names and aliases available to the connected account for use in evaluations.
